text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, turning the 4th corner,
and into the homestretch they come!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I'll finish this...!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Haaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Bubble Gum Fellow!!
It's the Big Four once again!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Alright!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Nuwaaaah!! I loooost!!
Bubble-chan, seriously, congratulations!!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...It's frustrating, but it's a complete defeat.
Still, I'm glad it was you who won, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You two—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today.
It was the best Satsuki Sho ever...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Next, we settle this at the Nippon Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Lapis & Cure
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Bubble Gum Fellow's completely
pulled ahead of the rest of the Big Four...!
Man, he's so strong...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, could a Triple Crown really be happening...? I'm getting my hopes up~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —...We did it, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...
...I'm so, so glad."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just like you, I will—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah――

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
That was truly incredible...
Everyone... truly...—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"So next time, I will definitely...
I will definitely make it there too...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For your trainee to win a Classic race.
As a Trainer, that was truly a glory I couldn't help but dream of.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Well, that goes both ways.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much
for bringing me here.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow takes my hand
and raises it high toward the stands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's share this together...! This roar of the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the Satsuki Sho that
Bubble Gum Fellow and I finally reached
ended in a glorious victory—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...While there is fatigue from the Satsuki Sho,
there doesn't appear to be any damage
that could lead to an injury."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you stay as mindful as you've been so far,
you should be able to run in the Japanese Derby without issue."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...That said, the Nippon Derby is longer than the
Satsuki Sho, and there's no doubt it will be
an even tougher race.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the fiercer a race becomes,
the more you must push your legs to win,
making you far more susceptible to taking damage.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even if things went well this time, injuries in future races
are still entirely possible.
Please always keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! Once we get back to the academy,
we've gotta get plenty of rest first.
choice_data_list: Yeah, right now it's important to relieve your fatigue.
Yeah, right now, shaking off the fatigue is what matters.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm taking a break today...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I can't wait.
The Nippon Derby, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Toward the grand stage to determine the pinnacle of their generation,
the Nippon Derby, they pressed forward with renewed resolve—"
